lastCompletedStory.title: Write post-merge-stalled marker on merged-but-failed post-merge

nextStoryContext: US-003 wired src/supervisor/post-merge-stalled-marker.ts (US-001) into the sidecar's merge-watch terminal branch. New exported helper `updatePostMergeStalledMarker(markerPath, outcome, state)` lives in src/commands/sidecar.ts right next to updateShipStalledMarker (same file, same terminal-branch call site in makeProductionMergeWatchFn: `removeMergeWatchState(watchFilePath); updateShipStalledMarker(...); updatePostMergeStalledMarker(join(claudeDir, POST_MERGE_STALLED_FILENAME), result.outcome, state);`). Behavior: a no-op unless outcome.kind==='merged' && outcome.postMerge.ok===false; on that exact branch it writes { prNumber: state.prNumber, issueId: state.issueId ?? null, completedSteps, remainingSteps, reason } (the last three lifted verbatim off outcome.postMerge, which US-002 already shapes this way) plus a fresh writtenAt ISO timestamp. Deliberately does NOT remove/clear the marker on a merged+ok:true outcome (scoped out by this story's notes: 'Only act when outcome.kind==="merged" && !outcome.postMerge.ok') and does NOT touch the ship-stalled marker or the merged classification at all -- updateShipStalledMarker is unchanged and still owns every non-merged terminal exclusively. US-004 (next, 'Surface post-merge-stalled at boot + document operator recovery') is the story that (a) reads this marker at orchestrator boot / recycle-recovery time, (b) adds the blocker line to templates/agents/subagent-orchestrator.md (+ .claude/agents/ dual-copy + embed-vendor regen), and (c) documents the operator recovery runbook -- none of that reading/surfacing/doc wiring exists yet after US-003, only the write side.
